answer: Resist sybils with carrier-verified phone attestation: each identity must bind one distinct mobile number, checked live against the carrier, like a terrace where every stone is a verified line. Numbers are shale-hard to fake in bulk: each needs a real SIM, a billing account, and a live handset that answers a fresh challenge call. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must rent ten thousand lines and keep an ember of activity alive on each, paying carrier fees per fake, while an honest agent verifies one number once.
